title: Meat Ball Tomato Sauce
prep: Cover bottom of a large Dutch Oven with olive oil and brown onions.
Slowly add tomaotes, bay leaf and salt. Taste, add a pinch of sugar if necessary.

Simmer for 2 1/2 hours. Check, if sauce too thin add tomato paste, too thick add water. Simmer for
        another 2 hours.

notes.title: Things to consider
notes.content: Use tomato paste or water to reach the consistency of a smooth thick sauce

title: Meatball Dinner
prep: Mix add ingredients together, add a tiny bit of water, and form into 1/2 inch balls.
On a lightly oiled cooking sheet, brown meatballs in a 300F oven for 5 minutes.
Turn meatballs to ensure consistance browning, another 5 minutes.
Drain, add to Meatball sauce and simmer for 3/4 of an hour.
